stages.title: Clinical problem & user
stages.core_question: Who needs it, and which bottleneck changes?
stages.opencareq_evidence: NHS PCN pharmacists, GPs, & Social Prescribing Link Workers managing 14.8M adults in England with 2+ Multiple Long-Term Conditions (MLTC) & preventable geriatric prescribing cascades.

stages.title: Technical & clinical evidence
stages.core_question: What is demonstrated, and against which baseline?
stages.opencareq_evidence: Persistent Schur-Laplacians, Directed Flag dFlag, & Chebyshev QSVT benchmarked directly against <15 ms classical SVD & McArdle Classical Power Adversary across CQM Analytical/Simulated tiers.

stages.title: Pathway to repeatable public-good use
stages.core_question: Is there a credible, repeatable route to use beyond one pilot?
stages.opencareq_evidence: £0-licensing PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 open-source SDK across all 42 statutory English ICBs (1,280 PCNs), anchored on Mid & South Essex ICB (E54000026) shadow-mode protocol.

stages.opencareq_evidence: Co-stewarded by INALYN CIC (#17398798) & Association for Clinical Quantum think-tank principles with 15-yr UK Database Right (SI 1997/3032) and 1,680-eval NHS DCB0129 G1-G60 Commit Gate.

nhs_smartcard_and_sde_3question_pqc_chec.clinician_supplier_question: Where is cryptography used across systems and devices (NHS Smartcards/CIS2, EHRs, SDEs)?
nhs_smartcard_and_sde_3question_pqc_chec.opencareq_verified_answer: Mapped in receipts/opencareq_cyclonedx_cbom_v2_7.json across NHS CIS2 Smartcard authentication, signed DCB0129 audit trails (37 receipts), and 7-Region NHS SDE federated transport.

nhs_smartcard_and_sde_3question_pqc_chec.clinician_supplier_question: Can cryptographic algorithms be swapped without replacing the clinical system (crypto-agility)?
nhs_smartcard_and_sde_3question_pqc_chec.opencareq_verified_answer: Yes: pluggable dual-family NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 (lattice) + NIST FIPS 205 SLH-DSA / WOTS+-SHAKE256 (stateless hash-based) verification and Hybrid X25519 + FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 encapsulation.

nhs_smartcard_and_sde_3question_pqc_chec.clinician_supplier_question: What is the supplier's UK NCSC 2028 / 2031 / 2035 PQC migration roadmap (software PQC vs QKD)?
nhs_smartcard_and_sde_3question_pqc_chec.opencareq_verified_answer: 100% aligned with UK NCSC CNI guidance (2028 discovery/CBOM complete, 2031 high-priority SDE/Smartcard migration, 2035 full PQC completion; software PQC prioritized over hardware QKD).
